title: Heavenly Shrine

Description

The Heavenly Shrine is a unique structure in Oaklands located in Snowy Peaks that serves as the primary method of spawning the rare Heavenly Tree. It uses a sundial and compass mechanism that activates several times per in-game day, each giving a small chance to generate a tree somewhere on the map.

Overview

The Heavenly Shrine is a large sundial with five openings. As the sun moves across the sky, its light shines through these holes at specific times of day, causing the shrine to activate. When this happens, there is a 10% chance that a Heavenly Tree will spawn somewhere in the world. The shrine can activate up to five times per in-game day, meaning five opportunities for a tree to appear.

In addition to the sundial, the shrine also features a compass-like device. When a Heavenly Tree successfully spawns, the compass begins to glow and points in the direction of the tree’s location. This allows players to track the tree more easily, though careful searching is still required to locate it.

Activation

The Heavenly Shrine only functions on Saturdays EST. On this day, the sun passes through the five holes of the sundial at fixed intervals, causing the shrine to activate. Each activation provides a 10% chance for a Heavenly Tree to spawn somewhere on the map.

The five activation times occur at 07:00, 09:30, 12:00, 14:30, and 17:00 in-game time. A maximum of five activations can occur during the day, giving players up to five separate chances to generate a Heavenly Tree each in-game day.

When a Heavenly Tree is successfully spawned and remains on the map, one of the shrine’s pillars will glow. The glowing pillar corresponds to the direction of the tree, acting as a compass to guide players toward its location.

Halloweenly

During the 2025 Halloween Event, the Heavenly Shrine is partially corrupted.

When the sun aligns at the second and third rings of the sundial, exactly as 9:30 and 12:00 respectively, will activate the Heavenly Shrine with a purple glow and attempts to spawn a Halloweenly instead.

When a Halloweenly is successfully spawned and remains on the map, the glowing pillar that corresponds to the direction will have a purple glow instead.

Trivia

  • The Heavenly Shrine is the only structure in Oaklands that uses the sun’s position to function.
  • It is the sole method of spawning the Heavenly Tree and Halloweenly.
  • It is the only structure that functions at a specific day of the week.
